stem: How do Caitlin's responses to Horatio in Scene 1 help develop the plot of the play?

options.label: A
options.text: They cause Horatio to become interested in other types of activities.

options.label: B
options.text: They prompt Horatio to make a commitment he will struggle to keep.

options.label: C
options.text: They cause Horatio to wonder if he has taken up too many responsibilities.

options.label: D
options.text: They prompt Horatio to make a plan for accomplishing his goal.
